title: Story Order · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Story Order · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner tells a three-event fictional story once. The lead repeats the three events in the order they happened. The repeated events and order match the story. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Story Order, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The repeated events and order match the story.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The repeated events and order match the story.
